title: Danse Macabre
description: Whenever you play a card that costs 2 Energy or more, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
upgraded_description: Whenever you play a card that costs 2 Energy or more, gain 6 [gold]Block[/gold].
notes: Triggered power that grants Block whenever a card costing 2 or more Energy is played. Upgrade increases block per trigger from 4 to 6.
